integrity: The proof derives the complete Euclidean structure from the published exact iterate formula, proves the edge basis is orthogonal, solves the inball directly from normalized facets, and proves minimum-enclosing optimality using explicit positive contact weights and a parallel-axis identity. The finite checker is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the distinguished stack-sorting simplex generated by the permutation \(\tau_n=23\cdots n1\) in the standard permutation-coordinate Euclidean realization. It does not assert analogous orthogonality or radius formulas for arbitrary stack-sorting simplices, and the metric statements are not preserved by general integral equivalence.
title: The canonical stack-sorting simplex is right, with a triangular-number minimum-sphere transition
